name: GAZ Tigr
armament: 7.62 mm PKP or 12.7 mm Kord on roof ring
AGS-17/30 grenade launcher or Kornet-D on variants
protection: Armoured steel body (protection roughly STANAG Level 2-3). Game: immune to small-calibre (5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51); 7.62x54R AP and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable tyres/engine; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Boxy 4x4 with a tall flat-sided cab, vertical slab sides and small square windows
Hummer-like stance, large single wheels, bull bar, roof hatch with gun ring
Rear swing door with spare wheel; Africa Corps vehicles in sand paint with white or no markings

colour_schemes.name: Russian protective green with white Z/V/triangle ID marks
